# Project preferences

- Write clean, dependency-free vanilla HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Do not add frameworks, libraries, or external runtime dependencies.
- Keep interactive elements accessible and keyboard-navigable, with semantic markup, clear focus indicators, and appropriate labels or live announcements.
- Respect the user's `prefers-color-scheme` setting when styling interfaces.
- Ensure every animation and transition respects `prefers-reduced-motion`, providing a reduced-motion alternative.
